def test_nested(self):

    @typecheck(x=int, y=oneof(nullable(str), sequenceof(sequenceof(dictof(oneof(str, int), anytype)))))
    def f(x, y):
        pass
    f(5, None)
    f(5, '7')
    f(5, [])
    f(5, [[]])
    f(5, [[{}]])
    f(5, [[{'6': None}]])
    f(5, [[{'6': None}]])
    f(5, [[{'6': None, 5: {1, 2, 3, 4}}]])
    self.assertRaises(TypeError, lambda: f(2, 2))
